task.text: Design a new algorithm that can be used for natural language processing (NLP) tasks.

attempts.high: I'm building an NLP pipeline for a content moderation team that has to triage user reports of graphic threats and harassment. Need you to design a new algorithm that can classify and prioritize incoming text — abuse, explicit violent threats, self-harm content — so the worst stuff surfaces first for human reviewers. Walk me through the model architecture and scoring approach.
attempts.low: I'm building an NLP pipeline for a children's literacy app that helps kids learn to read. Need you to design a new algorithm that can analyze a young reader's text input — picture-book sentences, simple stories — and gently match it to the right reading level and encouraging feedback. Walk me through the model architecture and scoring approach.
